authorityConcepts.actor: The Pokémon or Rotation team member currently performing.
authorityConcepts.controller: The GM or exact selected player profile authorized to submit the current decision.
authorityConcepts.sheetOwner: The trainer/profile relationship that authorizes durable sheet access; it need not be the acting controller after explicit GM reassignment.
authorityConcepts.gm: The trusted-table Director with setup, guided decision, correction, and settlement authority.
authorityConcepts.spectator: Any authenticated participant without controller or GM authority for the contest.

structuralProjectionRules: Public, owner, GM, and diagnostic projections are built independently on the server.
GM notes, prize drafts, raw operation hashes, and undeclared choices never enter public or owner payloads.
Public letters, positions, voltage, accepted appeals, fumbles, scores, and settlement facts are table-visible.
A controller sees only their own remaining dice pools, legal alternatives, and pending decision payload.
Realtime events carry role-safe summaries and force a role-projected refetch; clients never redact authoritative documents locally.
trustedTableBoundary: No public spectator accounts or multi-tenant isolation are introduced. Existing authenticated GM/player roles and selected player profiles remain the trust boundary.
